items.requirement: User-defined Tartarus visit caps per story-unlocked stage
items.evidence: Profile.java:51-65 adds per-block maps towerCapByBlock and towerVisitsByBlock next to the shared defaults. capFor and visitsFor are at Profile.java:93-106, and the maps round-trip through JSON with negative values clamped (Profile.java:178-181, 215-217, 238-246). Legality is enforced per block (Kernel.java:281-282), and a Heuristics.java:1148 veto keeps room for a rescue inside the cap. The independent validator checks each block's own cap (PlanValidator.java:160-164 capOf, 412-416 'Tartarus cap N exceeded in block b'). The UI has 规划设置 → 塔尔塔罗斯 (TowerSettingsPage.java): one card per pack block (10 story-unlocked blocks in assets/p3r/p3r_rules.json, tartarus.blocks with fromDay/toDay and floors), each with 想去几次 / 最多几次 steppers and 恢复默认. Every change saves and triggers a replan. The device screenshot qa_out/device/v301_tower_blocks.png shows 所有区块的默认 2/4 plus per-block cards (世俗之庭 台伯勒 2–22F 4/21–5/9 现在, 奇颜之庭 阿尔卡 …). qa_out/device/v301_tower_sheet.png shows '本区块第 1 次 · 上限 4 次'. Tests run now all pass (BUILD SUCCESSFUL): CoreContractTest 12/12, including eachBlockHasItsOwnCapAndWantedVisits, legalityFollowsTheCapOfTheCurrentBlock, validatorChecksTheCapOfEachBlock and unmetWantedVisitsOfOneBlockArePenalised. items.gap: No functional gap. Cosmetic only: the tower result sheet shows '本区块第 1 次' twice, once in the header and once in the caption (v301_tower_sheet.png).

items.requirement: Maximise explicit goals in priority order
items.evidence: What is fixed: goal weights are now spaced by priority. MUST_BASE is 100,000 and MUST_STEP is 25,000; WANT goals are spaced the same way far lower (Heuristics.java:119-130, 334). Two goalFirst tunings are added to the portfolio when goals exist (Planner.java GOAL_FIRST, portfolioFor). CoreContractTest.goalWeightsAreSpacedByPriority passes. PlanRealPackTest.goalOrderDecidesWhoGetsMaxWhenTwoMustGoalsCompete passes: from 1/8 with 力量 6 and 正义 6, ①力量 ②正义 gives 力量 MAX 1/27 with 正义 at RANK 8, and the swapped order gives 正义 MAX 1/28 with 力量 at RANK 8 (also in docs/PLAN_METRICS.md). twoMustGoalsBothFitInTheMidGame passes. Infeasibility wording is gone: grep finds no 时间不够/时间太紧/来不及/排不开/不可能 in main sources, and the notes say '按这次的安排预计停在 RANK n' or '这次的安排里没排到 MAX（先保证了X）' (Labels.java:593-623). CoreContractTest.notesNeverClaimAGoalIsImpossible passes. Running out of time is labelled separately: Planner.java:173-174 puts '这次没来得及算完，稍后会自动再算一次' first (Labels.java:31-33), and InfoPages.java:47-48 shows it. CoreContractTest.budgetRunOutIsSaidFirstAndPromisesOneMoreRun passes.
items.gap: Priority order is still not reliably honoured with three MUST goals. I ran a scratch probe against the real pack (/private/tmp/claude-501/p3r_reaudit/src/app/p3r/dayplanner/v3/engine/ReauditProbe2.java and ReauditProbe4.java, default options, mid-game 10/22 state from PlanRealPackTest). (1) MUST ①女教皇 ②女皇 ③恋爱 gives 女教皇 RANK 9, 女皇 MAX 1/26 and 恋爱 RANK 3. Goal ① is missed while ② is reached. The 2-goal plan for ①女教皇 ②女皇 reaches both MAX. That plan passes Engine.validate under the 3-goal profile with 0 errors and scores higher on the planner's own 3-goal objective (J 4,433,379 vs 3,680,779). (2) MUST ①恶魔 ②女皇 ③月亮 gives 恶魔 RANK 9 while 女皇 and 月亮 reach MAX; ①恶魔 ②女皇 alone gives both MAX (恶魔 12/22e). A random probe hit this in 1 of 50 mid-game triples, plus case (1), which I picked by hand. A 10 s or 60 s budget returns the same plan with budgetExhausted=false, so no search-limit note appears. The top goal gets only '按这次的安排预计停在 RANK 9'. Goal ③'s note blames the wrong goal: it says '（先保证了女皇）' when the trade actually cost goal ①. There is also no note that tells apart a calendar or rule-coverage shortfall (too few meeting days left under the model) from a heuristic shortfall; only the time-budget case is labelled.

items.requirement: Prefer less fragile routes and sensible resource buffers
items.evidence: Both mechanisms now exist. (a) Robustness: FRAGILE_MAX_PENALTY = 0.2·W_OTHER (Heuristics.java:100-109) is subtracted for each 其余社群 link that reaches MAX on its last meeting opportunity, when complete portfolio plans are compared (Planner.java:430-440, fragileMaxes at Heuristics.java:1317). Goals get a margin of one extra meeting per point-gated rank (Kernel.java:209, Profile.goalBuffer default on, shown as 目标多留一次见面 in qa_out/device/v301_settings.png). The forecast also counts no Tartarus income. (b) Cash: FEE_RESERVE = 2,500 is added to the money need ahead of unlock fees (Heuristics.java:110-117, 673, 701-704). The user-set hard reserve 手上至少留 (Profile.cashBuffer, Kernel.java:312/402/406/496, PlanValidator.java:390/455/530) is visible in qa_out/device/v301_settings2.png. CoreContractTest.fragileMaxCountsOnlyOtherLinksMaxedOnTheirLastChance and unlockFeesKeepAReserveOnTop pass. In a scratch replay at ordinaryGain 8 (ReauditProbe.java, log /private/tmp/claude-501/p3r_reaudit/probe.log), the 皇帝 MUST goal still reaches MAX.
items.gap: The fee reserve is soft and often not kept, yet every fee-paying plan carries the note '需要付钱解锁的社群，安排会在付钱前尽量多留 2,500 日元'. Measured on the real pack with default options: in the new game with default profile (22/22 MAX), 2 of 4 fee payments leave less than ¥2,500. On 8/29 evening the plan pays the ¥10,000 Devil fee with only ¥830 to spare and also buys a ¥680 定食若津 meal, ending at ¥150. That contradicts the Heuristics.java:113 claim that paid training does not eat into the reserve. Other cases: new game 皇帝 MUST ends at ¥710 on 9/26e (Devil fee plus a ¥1,000 burger). Mid-game MUST 女教皇 ends at ¥100. Mid-game ①正义 ②力量 leaves ¥1,520 and ¥1,120. No test asserts that the reserve actually holds in a plan. The robustness preference is only a 0.2-RANK tie-break between 16–18 finished plans (deliberately kept out of the search), and last-chance MAXes remain: 1 in the default new game (lovers), 1 in mid-game (temperance), 2–3 in goal scenarios. Non-goal MAX counts drop sharply if gains come in lower than estimated (new game 22→13 MAX at ordinaryGain 8 without a replan). Mitigating factors: replanning, conservative defaults, the goal buffer and zero forecast tower income.

The planner only uses romance gains when the route is ROMANCE (Model.java:93-95, PlanValidator.java:670-671), and the pack has eventGainRomance null for every link (RulesPackFactsTest:171). For friend-route players the dialogue drops answers the guide marks as romance (恋人线/恋爱线 plus quoted answers) and uses a neutral hint for unmarked RANK≥8 scenes, adding '只想做朋友的话，别选表白的回答' (Dialogue.java:25-42, 66-145). items.gap: No planner gap. Two notes: there is no device (v301_*) screenshot of the 朋友/恋人 control itself, only Robolectric coverage. items.requirement: F6. Evidence-backed recurring availability with known exceptions; weekday rules never override forced story events or an accepted invitation
items.evidence: You can now enter an accepted 12/24 invitation in two places. (1) 规划设置 → 平安夜: ui/SettingsPage.java:59-60 and 71-80 build the card from ui/ChristmasChoice.java:70-110, offering 都婉拒了 or 接受了XX的邀约 for romanceable links at RANK 1 or above. (2) The state wizard: ui/StateSteps.java:567-571 and ui/StateDraft.java:341-356, always shown in 修改进度 and in 同步现状 from 12/20. The choice is stored as Profile.christmasLink (model/Profile.java:69-71 and 108-121) and is part of the plan hash (engine/PlanHash.java:48-53). With an invitation accepted, the engine locks BOTH 12/24 slots with reason christmas_date: engine/Tables.java:124-131 and 176-177 (via engine/Model.java:61). A locked slot gets no meeting cells and no activity cells, so no weekday training/job/meeting can be scheduled. The validator works the lock out independently (engine/PlanValidator.java:150-157). Alternatives and slot normalisation also respect it (service/PlannerService.java:359; store/StateShape.java:49-55). Tests I ran in this audit, all passing: CoreContractTest.acceptedChristmasEveInvitationLocksBothSlots (both slots are locked:christmas_date / 平安夜约会, legalActions empty, validator rejects the declined plan; 12/12 in class), FeaturesTest.planTextAvoidsBannedWords (16/16), ProfileContractTest.acceptedChristmasEveInvitationTakesBothSlotsOfTheDay (7/7), RulesPackFactsTest.christmasEveIsFreeByDefault and christmasDateLockReasonIsDeclaredButUnusedByTheCalendar on the real pack (45/45), and AuditFixesTest settingsChristmasListsRomanceableLinksAtRankOneOrAbove / wizardAsksAboutChristmasInEditModeAndSavesIt / syncAsksAboutChristmasOnlyFromDecember20 / anAcceptedInvitationReadsAsADate (21/21). The default is disclosed in 规划说明 (ui/Assumptions.java:112-115). Screenshots: qa_out/device/v301_settings_xmas.png (device; card present, only 都婉拒了 listed because no romanceable link is at RANK 1 in that state), qa_out/v3/ui/home_settings_christmas.png (candidates listed, 山岸风花 selected), qa_out/v3/ui/state_edit_christmas_confirm.png.
items.gap: Nothing blocking. Minor points: there is no device screenshot of an accepted invitation or of a 12/24 locked plan row (Robolectric only). The candidate list uses the recorded ranks, so a romanceable link that has not been synced to RANK 1 or above does not appear. The wizard's date picker (ui/StateSteps.java:392-421) checks only the pack locks (rules.lockOf), so the player can still pick 12/24 as the current slot; the service and engine skip the slot anyway.

items.requirement: F11. Never claim a failed heuristic search proves infeasibility; distinguish unmet goals, rule coverage and search limits
items.evidence: The infeasibility wording is fixed. Unmet goals now read as what this plan does: engine/Labels.java:592-627 gives 「按这次的安排预计停在 RANK X」, 「这次的安排里没排到 MAX（先保证了…）」 and 「这次的安排里还没满足解锁条件（需要…）」, and ui/LinkStatus.java's shortfall() uses the same style. Rule-coverage cases are worded separately: story holds (「RANK n 暂时无法升级（要等剧情推进）」, Labels.java:725-736), a lost rescue, and locked-slot reasons. The search limit has its own note (Labels.java:31-33, added first by Planner.java:173-174). The promised re-run now exists: PlannerService.java:776-779 (needsFollowUpLocked), 893-904 and 936-940 queue exactly one follow-up with twice the budget. Tests run in this audit, all passing: CoreContractTest.notesNeverClaimAGoalIsImpossible (INFEASIBLE_WORDS at line 23: 时间不够/时间太紧/来不及/排不开/不可能), CoreContractTest.budgetRunOutIsSaidFirstAndPromisesOneMoreRun, FeaturesTest.planTextAvoidsBannedWords (BANNED includes 时间不够/不可能/做不到), and PlannerServiceFollowUpTest 5/5 (anExhaustedPlanGetsExactlyOneFollowUpWithTwiceTheBudget, aFollowUpThatRunsOutAgainIsNotRepeatedAndOnlyReplacesWhenBetter, aFailedFollowUpKeepsTheInstalledPlanWithoutAnError, …).
items.gap: The 规划说明 page can still promise a re-run that never happens. ui/InfoPages.java:47-48 adds 「这次没来得及算完，后半段先粗略排好了，稍后会自动再算一次。」 for EVERY plan with budgetExhausted. It does not distinguish the follow-up plan, and Plan has no follow-up flag it could check. Case (a): a follow-up that runs out of time again but is better gets installed (the fake-4 path in aFollowUpThatRunsOutAgainIsNotRepeatedAndOnlyReplacesWhenBetter). No further run is queued (followUpKey == planKey), yet the card still says 稍后会自动再算一次, which contradicts the plan's own bullet 「记下一个结果后会重新安排」 shown underneath. Case (b): when the follow-up does not improve or fails, the first plan stays installed. Its card line and its BUDGET_NOTE bullet both still say 稍后会自动再算一次 after that run has already happened, and nothing more runs until the next write or an app restart. In the normal case the card line also duplicates the bullet. 「后半段先粗略排好了」 is also wrong when time ran out only during the fortify loop (Planner.java:155-159): the plan is a complete base-policy plan with fewer variants fortified. No test covers the InfoPages budget text.

items.requirement: I3. Unknown is not zero; unrelated saves must not erase bounds or observations
items.evidence: Both parts of the earlier gap are addressed. (1) '?' ranks: in 同步现状/修改进度, '?' keeps the recorded rank, points, cue and unlock progress, never the forecast (ui/StateDraft.java:476-485). In onboarding, the confirm page now lists every '?' link as 「不确定（先按未解锁安排）」 (StateDraft.java:52-53 and 627-643), so it is no longer silent. Test AuditFixesTest.onboardingListsUnsureRanksOnTheConfirmPage passes; screenshot qa_out/v3/ui/state_onboarding_unsure_ranks.png. (2) A recorded 没救出 is kept. StateDraft.rescueAnswer/recordSaysFailed (StateDraft.java:266-287) preselect 没救出 with 「上次记录的结果，如果其实救出了请改。」. build() (StateDraft.java:498-520) keeps the bit unless the player changes it, and clears it only when the chosen date is back inside the window. Checkpoints loaded with a layout treat rescueFailed as explicit, so inference cannot revive the link (store/CheckpointRow.java:42-56; store/StateShape.java:103-117). The episode opt-in save copies the record unchanged (ui/LinksPage.java withWatched). Tests run in this audit, all passing: ReviewFixesTest 29/29 (ui7_recordedFailureIsPreselectedAndKeptUntilChanged, ui7_recordedFailureWhileTheWindowIsOpenIsNotKept, ui7_wizardPreselectsTheRecordedFailureWithANote, f3_optingInMidGameSavesWatchedEpisodesWithTheProfile), PlannerServiceRound2Test.rescuesAreInferredWhenTheCheckpointIsSaved (13/13), StateShapeTest 4/4. Screenshot qa_out/v3/ui/state_edit_rescue_recorded_failure.png.
items.gap: Nothing blocking. Residuals: (a) an onboarding '?' is still stored as RANK 0 with no 'unknown' marker. After the one-time confirm-page notice, later 同步现状/修改进度 prefill, LinkStatus and the plan treat it as a confirmed 未解锁. That is a disclosed conservative lower bound, not a preserved unknown. (b) service/PlannerApi.java:219-227 still says the wizard must not copy a replay-set rescueFailed bit unless the player confirmed it, but StateDraft does copy it, presented as 上次记录的结果 (the test fixture is named maikoLostByReplay). The behaviour is defensible because records cannot skip slots (CommandCheck.java:85 rejects gaps), but the doc and the code disagree.

items.requirement: I10. Normal predicted results easy to accept without re-entering unrelated info
items.evidence: The tower sheet no longer saves a silent zero. A new record starts with an empty amount, and 保存 stays disabled until an amount is typed or 「不记得钱了」 is tapped (ui/TowerPanel.java:142-145 and 292-299). 「不记得钱了」 records +0 and marks the cash as a lower bound, not an exact value (ResultRealServiceTest.towerSheetForgotCashRecordsNoChange asserts cashExact false). When the plan predicts the rescue, 救出了 is preselected: ResultActivity.predictsRescue (ui/ResultActivity.java:968-983) reads the engine's rescue_on_visit assumption (engine/Kernel.java:41 and 726) or 「救出X」 in the subtitle, and TowerPanel.java:166-174 sets the selection. Corrections are preset from the record. The widget's Done button records directly only for training/job steps (widget/PlanWidget.java:196-203); tower steps open the result sheet. Tests run in this audit, all passing: AuditFixesTest.towerSheetStartsEmptyAndPreselectsThePredictedRescue, towerSheetWithoutAPredictedRescueAsksWithStillOpenSelected, typingAnAmountAfterForgotUsesTheAmount; ResultRealServiceTest 6/6 including towerSheetRescuePreselectedFromThePlanIsStored (real service and pack: rescued bit set, rescueFailed clear); ResultFlowsRealPackTest 6/6. Screenshots: qa_out/device/v301_tower_sheet.png (device 3.0.1: empty amount 「点这里输入」, 保存 disabled, 不记得钱了 offered), qa_out/v3/ui/result_real_tower_rescue.png (11/2 sheet with 救出了 preselected).
items.gap: Nothing blocking. There is no on-device screenshot of a tower sheet inside a rescue window; the 救出了 preselection is shown only in a Robolectric render. The cash amount still has to be typed, or 不记得钱了 tapped, which is the relevant result for a tower trip rather than unrelated information.
